note_en: 既然 A，就 B means "since A, then B": 既然 introduces a fact already accepted, and 就 the conclusion or action that naturally follows. In the text: 既然决定要考，就得全力以赴 "since I've decided to take the exam, I have to give it everything"; 既然知道问题在哪儿了……就别再靠感觉了 "since you know where the problem is, stop relying on feel." Unlike 因为…所以…, it doesn't explain a cause; it draws a practical conclusion from a known fact.
